Definition
[Seifert fibered manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0214 1. ch31:31.53\group Collapsing 3-manifolds

A Seifert fibered 3-manifold is a compact 3-manifold carrying a foliation by circles. Solid tori with the model foliations $\mathbf F_{p,q}$ are the building blocks; finite covers are products or circle bundles over surfaces.
